title: Elite Gourmet EHC112 Personal Single-Serve Compact Coffee Maker Brewer Includes 14Oz. Thermal Travel Mug with Stainless Steel Interior, Compatible with Coffee Grounds, Reusable Filter, Black

reviews.body: I really enjoy this coffee brewer—it heats up quickly and is perfect for making one to two servings, depending on how much water you use. It comes with a thermal carafe and lid, and the price feels very reasonable for the quality. You can smell the coffee as it starts brewing, which is a nice touch,...

I love this little coffee maker. Perfect for one 12 oz. Cup of coffee. It has a built in filter that is removable for easy cleaning. Just rinse under the faucet. Takes about a minute to brew a cup and it comes with its own travel mug with lid. Great little coffee maker and inexpensive too!
